meta.name: apple-design
meta.description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.

copy.tagline: 让网页界面拥有苹果式的流畅动效与精致交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在构建或评审网页界面时追求苹果式的动效与交互细节。
copy.tagline_en: Create web interfaces with Apple-like fluid motion and gesture interactions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or review web UIs and care about Apple-style motion and interaction details.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会依据 Apple 的界面设计原则来构建或审查网页界面：强调按下即反馈、物体与手指 1:1 追踪、动画可随时打断并继承速度、用弹簧动画表达运动，并给出对应的 CSS/JS 实现。
howto.when: 当你在构建或审查手势驱动的界面、弹簧动画、拖拽/滑动/弹层交互时，Claude 会触发这套设计知识。

say.text: 给我一个可打断的弹簧动画，拖拽卡片松手后按初速度继续飞。
用 backdrop-filter 做毛玻璃工具栏，内容从下面滚过去。
say.note: Claude 会给出透明层次和滚动边缘的处理建议。

say.text: 按 Apple 原则审查这个弹窗：进入从右侧滑入，退出应该往哪走？
say.note: Claude 会检查空间一致性和路径对称。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude applies Apple's interface design principles when building or reviewing web UI: instant feedback on press, 1:1 tracking of pointer, interruptible animations that inherit velocity, spring-based motion, and concrete CSS/JS implementations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you are building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, etc.

say_en.text: Build a frosted-glass toolbar with backdrop-filter and content scrolling underneath.
say_en.note: Claude suggests translucency hierarchy and scroll edge effects.

say_en.text: Review this modal per Apple principles: it enters from the right — where should it exit?
say_en.note: Claude checks spatial consistency and symmetric paths.
